nodes.label: Generador de Invitaciones XV - Digital Invitation Generator
nodes.rationale: Single-page React app for building and sharing digital invitations for Mexican quinceañera (XV años) parties, with editor, guest view, and catalog modes
nodes.norm_label: generador de invitaciones xv - digital invitation generator

nodes.label: Canonical Repository Status
nodes.rationale: administradorinvitamx is the official maintained repo as of 2026-07-27; other repos (invitacionesmx, invitamx, INVITAMXGEN, admin-hanny, hanny-xv-admin) are stale duplicates that diverged independently

nodes.label: templates.ts - HTML Generation and Guest View
nodes.rationale: Generates entire guest-facing invitation as single self-contained HTML string with inline styles, lightbox, countdown, opening animation
nodes.norm_label: templates.ts - html generation and guest view

nodes.label: App.tsx - Editor UI and Query-Param Routing
nodes.rationale: ~3200 lines containing editor UI, three routing-free modes (editor, view, catalog) selected from URL query params
nodes.norm_label: app.tsx - editor ui and query-param routing

nodes.label: middleware.ts - Vercel Edge Middleware and Admin Auth
nodes.rationale: Gates editor behind HTTP Basic Auth via ADMIN_PASSWORD env var; lets through public query-param modes (?v=1, ?catalog=true, ?intake=1); matcher excludes public API routes
nodes.norm_label: middleware.ts - vercel edge middleware and admin auth

nodes.label: api/notify-telegram.ts - Telegram Bot Notifications
nodes.rationale: Vercel serverless function using Node handler signature (req, res), not Web-standard Request/Response; uses TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env vars

nodes.label: api/admin/list-invitaciones.ts - Bulk Invitations Read
nodes.rationale: Server-side endpoint using SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY to bypass RLS; returns all rows filtered by admin auth

nodes.label: api/admin/abonos.ts - Bulk Payments Read
nodes.rationale: Server-side endpoint using SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY for dashboard revenue aggregation

nodes.label: InvitacionDatos - Core Invitation Content Schema
nodes.rationale: Central data shape containing event details, ceremony/reception, itinerary, guest list, photos, theme, package, and all invitation-specific configuration

nodes.label: PaqueteConfig - Package Tier Configuration
nodes.rationale: Defines which sections are enabled and max photo count per package tier

nodes.label: TemaConfig - Theme Visual Configuration
nodes.rationale: Visual theme definition with font, color, gradient, custom CSS per theme

nodes.label: Invitation Themes - 12 Pre-Built + 1 Custom
nodes.rationale: 12 themes: Dorado Clásico, Vuelo de Mariposas, Floral Acuarela, Místico Celestial, Eucalipto Botánico, Glam Rose Oro, Rustique Boho Chic, Princesa Elegante, Mármol & Oro Geométrico, Ciber Cyber Neon, XV Coquette Listones Rose, XV Coquette Luxe; plus 1 custom A Medida theme

nodes.label: Invitation Packages - Básico, Premium, Deluxe
nodes.rationale: Three tiers differentiated by max photo count (4/8/14) and included features; pases/PDF pricing differs by tier

nodes.label: RSVP Tracking - confirmaciones Table and Integration
nodes.rationale: Guest RSVP confirmation flows through WhatsApp (templates.ts enviarRSVPWhatsApp), stores in confirmaciones table with FK to invitaciones.id, tracked in Mis Invitaciones UI
nodes.norm_label: rsvp tracking - confirmaciones table and integration

nodes.label: Pases - Per-Guest Personalized Passes
nodes.rationale: Per-family personalized pass with name and pase count; included in Deluxe, à-la-carte in Básico/Premium; requires per-guest link generation via getShareUrl(invitadoIndex)

nodes.label: Control de Acceso QR - Check-In via QR Code
nodes.rationale: Door check-in system; requires pases to be active; each pase renders QR linking to /?checkin=1&iid=<invitacion id>&fam=<familia>; CheckinPage shows single-family confirm or searchable family list
nodes.norm_label: control de acceso qr - check-in via qr code

nodes.label: Manual Access Blocking - bloqueada + motivo_bloqueo
nodes.rationale: Admin-controlled blocking of guest links via bloqueada boolean and motivo_bloqueo (evento_pasado | cancelado | falta_pago | solicitud_cliente | otro); checked via iid lookup before guest view renders

nodes.label: Client Intake Form - ?intake=1&iid=<row id>
nodes.rationale: Public, login-free page for clients to self-fill fecha/ceremonia/recepción/itinerario/padrinos/regalo and upload photos; merges into datos_completos on save; sets intake_actualizado_en timestamp

nodes.label: Telegram Bot Notifications to Admin
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget POST to /api/notify-telegram from IntakeForm handleEnviarAvisoPago/handleEnviar and RSVP flow; notifies admin via @invitqmxbot when client submits or confirms

nodes.label: Anti-Spam Rate Limiting - PostgreSQL Triggers
nodes.rationale: BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE triggers (rl_confirmaciones, rl_avisos_pago, rl_invitaciones_intake) enforce limits: 15 confirmaciones/10min/invitacion, 5 avisos_pago/10min/invitacion, 15sec minimum intake resubmit; global circuit-breaker per 5min

nodes.label: Mis Invitaciones - Client Order Management Panel
nodes.rationale: Lists all saved rows with search/filter by name/tema/estatus; supports CSV export, duplicate, delete, re-open; shows saldo pendiente and event-in-14-days filters; RSVP count/list viewer
nodes.norm_label: mis invitaciones - client order management panel

nodes.label: Nuevo Cliente - Quick Order Creation
nodes.rationale: Name + phone + package creates Supabase row immediately with estatus=cotizacion; tracks sale from moment it's made

nodes.label: Ingresos Dashboard - Revenue Aggregation
nodes.rationale: Aggregates across all saved invitaciones; computed from abonos table (has payment dates); shows histórico, month-by-month, pendiente, cobrado-por-paquete

nodes.label: invitaciones Table - Supabase Core Schema
nodes.rationale: Stores full invitation state; columns: id, datos_completos (jsonb), nombre_quinceanera, fecha_fiesta, estatus, precio_total, precio_pagado, pases_pagado, pdf_pagado, notas, link_pago, intake_actualizado_en, activo_hasta, bloqueada, motivo_bloqueo, checkin_pagado, and others

nodes.label: confirmaciones Table - RSVP Records
nodes.rationale: Stores guest RSVP entries with FK invitacion_id; written directly from anonymous guest via anon key with RLS allow all

nodes.label: abonos Table - Payment Transaction Records
nodes.rationale: Payment transactions with real payment dates; only source for revenue aggregation with timestamps

nodes.label: avisos_pago Table - Payment Notifications
nodes.rationale: Records when client notifies admin of payment; written via anon key; rate-limited by rl_avisos_pago trigger

nodes.label: checkins Table - Door Check-In Records
nodes.rationale: Records per-family arrivals with personas_registradas; allows multiple rows per family (partial arrivals); RLS allow all; rate-limited with higher thresholds (300/10min per invitacion)

nodes.label: Supabase - Backend Database and RLS
nodes.rationale: Project ahwcilcejffgddeeuiux; client created via @supabase/supabase-js from VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY; exposed as window.supabaseClient; all tables use RLS with USING (true) for public writes

nodes.label: Cloudinary - Image Upload and CDN
nodes.rationale: Direct unsigned upload from browser to cloud dswrrm5u1 with preset invitaciones-xv; used for photos, backgrounds, custom per-theme images

nodes.label: WhatsApp - Sharing and Communication
nodes.rationale: Builds https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=...&text=... links for sharing and confirmation flows; no API integration, client-side window.open only

nodes.label: Vercel - Single Project Deployment
nodes.rationale: administradorinvitamx project deployed at https://administradorinvitamx.vercel.app; serves editor, guest view, catalog, intake form from same URL via query-param routing

nodes.label: State Diffing - URL-Encoded Invitation Delta
nodes.rationale: encodeState/decodeState diffs against datosDefault[paquete]; only serializes changed fields using KEY_MAP/SUB_KEY_MAP aliases to keep links short and avoid 2KB URL limit

nodes.label: Base64 URL Encoding - Compact State Blob
nodes.rationale: Invitation data encoded into d URL param as base64 blob; embedded photos stripped, fall back to theme defaults; Cloudinary URLs used for custom photo sharing
nodes.norm_label: base64 url encoding - compact state blob

nodes.label: localStorage Persistence - xv_datos_invitacion
nodes.rationale: Invitation data auto-persisted to localStorage on every change; per-theme backgrounds in xv_fondos_personalizados; per-theme catalog tweaks in xv_diseño_guardado_tema_${temaId}

nodes.label: Theme Customization - Personalized A Medida Theme
nodes.rationale: 13th theme option for 100% custom colors/fonts/opening style; ángulo de venta premium/exclusividad
nodes.norm_label: theme customization - personalized a medida theme

nodes.label: Animated Opening Styles - Card, Envelope, Curtain
nodes.rationale: Three opening animations (tarjeta, sobre con sello, cortina) selectable independent of theme; special-cased by theme id in generarHTMLFinal
nodes.norm_label: animated opening styles - card, envelope, curtain

nodes.label: Decorative Rain Effect - Animated Particles
nodes.rationale: Pétalos, mariposas, listones, estrellas, etc. falling animation per theme

nodes.label: Live Countdown Timer - Event Countdown
nodes.rationale: Real-time countdown to event date rendered in guest view

nodes.label: Photo Gallery - Carousel with Lightbox
nodes.rationale: Carrusel and tap-to-expand lightbox for invitation photos

nodes.label: PDF Download - Invitation as PDF Memento
nodes.rationale: PDF export via html2canvas/jspdf; included in Deluxe, à-la-carte in others; pricing noted in policy
nodes.norm_label: pdf download - invitation as pdf memento

nodes.label: Background Music Player - Event Soundtrack
nodes.rationale: Audio player in guest view for client-selected event music

nodes.label: Google Maps Integration - Ceremony/Reception Directions
nodes.rationale: Direct link from invitation to Google Maps for venue addresses

nodes.label: Calendar Add-To-Calendar Button
nodes.rationale: Button to add event to guest's personal calendar

nodes.label: Instagram Hashtag Section - Event Hashtag Display
nodes.rationale: Dedicated section for event Instagram hashtag; package-exclusive to Premium/Deluxe
nodes.norm_label: instagram hashtag section - event hashtag display

nodes.label: Gift Registry Section - Mesa de Regalos
nodes.rationale: Bank account info and copy-to-clipboard for CLABE; package-exclusive to Premium/Deluxe
nodes.norm_label: gift registry section - mesa de regalos

nodes.label: Parents and Godparents Section - Familia y Padrinos
nodes.rationale: Displays parents and padrinos; package-exclusive to Premium/Deluxe
nodes.norm_label: parents and godparents section - familia y padrinos

nodes.label: Pricing - Básico Package
nodes.rationale: $499 MXN, 4 fotos max, no pases/PDF included; pases à-la-carte $150 MXN for up to 10 familias

nodes.label: Pricing - Premium Package
nodes.rationale: $799 MXN, 8 fotos max, includes familia/regalos/hashtag/calendario sections; pases à-la-carte $180 MXN for up to 20 familias

nodes.label: Pricing - Deluxe Package
nodes.rationale: $1,199-1,499 MXN, 14 fotos max, pases and PDF included at no extra charge for up to 40 familias

nodes.label: Pases Pricing - Per-Guest Pass Feature
nodes.rationale: Deluxe: included for 40 familias, then $15-20 MXN each; Premium: $180 MXN for 20 familias, then $15-20 each; Básico: $150 MXN for 10 familias, then $15-20 each

nodes.label: QR Control de Acceso Pricing
nodes.rationale: Flat $150 MXN regardless of package, always requires pases; never standalone

nodes.label: Payment Policy - 50% Deposit
nodes.rationale: 50% upfront to reserve date and start design, remaining 50% due on delivery

nodes.label: Delivery Turnaround - 24-48 Hours
nodes.rationale: 24-48 hours after receiving all client data; faster than competitor ~72h, selling point

nodes.label: Post-Delivery Edits Policy
nodes.rationale: First 2 rounds free within 7 days of delivery; each additional edit costs $99-150 MXN

nodes.label: Sections - Dynamic Content Blocks
nodes.rationale: Sections (ceremonia, galeria, regalos, etc.) are string ids per-package; each has HTML in SECCIONES_CONTENIDO_HTML map in templates.ts; togglable via seccionesExcluidas, toggling doesn't warrant discount

nodes.label: Section Order - Dynamic Reordering
nodes.rationale: datos.ordenSecciones (array of section ids); getOrdenSeccionesEfectivo validates order, drops invalid, appends missing; apertura/cierre always first/last

nodes.label: Business Features List - Sales Copy Reference
nodes.rationale: Quick reference of all product features for sales/landing copy, organized by buyer value (what invitee sees, buyer experience); deliberately excludes promises about payment gateway, app, or SMS
nodes.norm_label: business features list - sales copy reference

nodes.label: html2canvas - Version 1.4.1
nodes.rationale: Used for PDF generation via jspdf

nodes.label: jspdf - Version 4.2.1
nodes.rationale: PDF export from invitation HTML

nodes.label: @google/genai - Version 2.4.0
nodes.rationale: AI Studio template boilerplate; not currently referenced in src/

nodes.label: index.html - HTML Root and Entry Point
nodes.norm_label: index.html - html root and entry point

nodes.label: Open Graph Meta Tags - Static Sharing Preview
nodes.rationale: Static og:title/description for WhatsApp/Telegram/iMessage sharing; intentionally not personalized per invitation since bots don't run JS
nodes.norm_label: open graph meta tags - static sharing preview

nodes.label: vercel.json - Single Page App Rewrite
nodes.rationale: Rewrites /((?!api/).*)  to /index.html for client-side routing; excludes /api/* to let API routes work

nodes.label: vercel.json - CSP frame-ancestors Headers
nodes.rationale: Allows embedding from invitacionmx-catalogo.vercel.app, invitacionmx-landing.vercel.app, invitamx.online, localhost dev ports

nodes.label: .env.example - Gemini API Key
nodes.rationale: AI Studio boilerplate; not currently used in src/

nodes.label: tsconfig.json - JSX Configuration
nodes.rationale: jsx: react-jsx with path alias @/* for root imports
